description: Input: the same fields as quote_faceless, plus attempt. Start a faceless video from a script or brief: an opening clip and image scenes. You select 30–90 seconds; it ends with its narration, at least 25 seconds (an explainer, as long as its narration) and at most a quarter past the selection, never beyond 90. Captions are on unless turned off. Poll get_run. attempt=2,3,… starts a NEW run. Price: generated picture 7 credits per image plus opening clip 49 credits per clip plus production (story, voice and render) 1 credits per second of video, at least 50. Quote first with quote_faceless.
name: make_faceless
title: Make a faceless video
